description: This PHP source file defines the AdminUserRole class within the OrangeHRM application, which manages user role permissions and access rights for various entities such as employees, projects, customers, and other HR-related data. It utilizes multiple traits for modular functionality and provides methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs based on user permissions.

classes.name: AdminUserRole
classes.description: A class defining role-based access control logic for administrative users within the OrangeHRM system, managing permissions for various entities and integrating multiple service traits.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LocationService.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns a list of entity IDs that the user has access to, based on the entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIds
methods.description: Retrieves employee IDs accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleLocationIds
methods.description: Retrieves location IDs accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleSystemUserIds
methods.description: Retrieves system user IDs accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleUserRoleIds
methods.description: Retrieves user role IDs that are accessible for assignment or viewing.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Returns employees associated with this user role.

methods.name: getAccessibleProjectIds
methods.description: Retrieves project IDs accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleCustomerIds
methods.description: Retrieves customer IDs accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancyIds
methods.description: Retrieves vacancy IDs accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerIds
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker IDs accessible to the current user.

methods.description: Retrieves performance review IDs accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerLogIds
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker log IDs accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateIds
methods.description: Retrieves candidate IDs accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves interview IDs accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewAttachmentIds
methods.description: Retrieves interview attachment IDs accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateHistoryIds

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateActionHistoryIds
methods.description: Retrieves candidate action history IDs accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of quick launch options accessible to the user.
